description: This file defines the JwtInvalidException class, a custom exception used to indicate invalid JSON Web Tokens within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing and manipulating instances, including a builder pattern, and parses JSON input to create exception objects.

classes.name: JwtInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating an invalid JWT token, extends DittoRuntimeException and implements JwtException.

classes.name: JwtInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing JwtInvalidException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder for JwtInvalidException.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a JwtInvalidException by parsing a JsonObject and including headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new JwtInvalidException with updated DittoHeaders.
